p.i: Alma’s commandments to his son Helaman.

chapter.li: LEChapter36 Verse1 My son, listen carefully. I promise 2PSF you that to the extent 2PSF you keep God’s commandments, 2PSF you’ll prosper in the land. VerseEnd Verse2 I want 2PSF you to follow my example and always remember our ancestors’ captivity. Because when they were slaves no one could save them except for the God of Abraham and the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob — He certainly rescued them from their misery. VerseEnd Verse3 Now Helaman my son, 2PSF you are young, and I urge 2PSF you to listen and learn what I tell 2PSF you, because I’ve seen that anyone who puts their trust in God will have His assistance during their trials, troubles, and difficulties and will be saved on the last day. VerseEnd Verse4 Don’t think I understand this just from what I’ve seen, because it isn’t the result of earthly experience alone but has been confirmed by the Spirit: not from the carnal mind but from God. VerseEnd

Verse5 Now I tell 2PSF you: If I hadn’t been born of God, I wouldn’t have understood these things. Remember God revealed them to me by His holy angel, and not because I had done anything to be worthy of it. VerseEnd Verse6 Indeed, I went with Mosiah’s sons trying to destroy God’s congregation. But God sent His holy angel to stop us while we were making trouble. VerseEnd Verse7 He spoke to us as if with a voice of thunder — the whole earth shook beneath our feet. And we all fell to the ground because we all feared the Lord. VerseEnd Verse8 But the voice said to me: Get up. And I stood up on my feet and saw the angel. VerseEnd Verse9 And he said to me: End 2PSI your efforts to destroy the congregation, unless 2PSI you want to be destroyed! VerseEnd

Verse10 Then I fell to the ground, and I couldn’t open my mouth or use my limbs for three days and nights. VerseEnd Verse11 And the angel said more things to me, which were heard by my companions, but I didn’t hear them. Because when I heard the words: End 2PSI your efforts to destroy the congregation, unless 2PSI you want to be destroyed! I was struck with such great fear and amazement thinking I might be destroyed, that I collapsed and didn’t hear anything else. VerseEnd Verse12 But I was tortured with eternal torment — my soul suffered to the greatest extent and was tortured by guilt over all my sins. VerseEnd Verse13 I remembered every sin and all my iniquities, and they tormented me with the pains of hell. Indeed, I could see my rebellion against God and that I hadn’t kept His holy commandments. VerseEnd Verse14 And I had effectively murdered many of His children by leading them away to destruction — to be clear, my iniquities had been so overwhelming that the very thought of coming into the presence of God tortured my soul with inexpressible horror. VerseEnd Verse15 I thought to myself: I wish I could vanish and cease all existence, both spirit and body, so I could avoid being brought to stand in the presence of God to be judged for my actions. VerseEnd Verse16 And now I was tortured with the pains of a damned soul for three days and nights. VerseEnd

Verse17 And as I was tortured like this, while I was pained by the memory of my many sins, I also remembered hearing my father prophesy to the people about the coming of one Jesus Christ, a Son of God, to atone for the world’s sins. VerseEnd Verse18 Now as my mind took ahold of this thought, I cried out within my heart: O Jesus, Son of God, have mercy on me — I bitterly regret my life and I feel doomed to everlasting death. VerseEnd Verse19 Now when I prayed this, I was released from my pains; indeed, I was no longer tormented by the memory of my sins. VerseEnd Verse20 But then, I felt such joy, and I saw such light! My soul was filled with joy as great as had been my pains. VerseEnd Verse21 Indeed, I tell 2PSF you, my son, nothing is as intense and bitter as were my pains.

But my son, on the other hand, from my experience there’s nothing as intense and sweet as was my joy. VerseEnd Verse22 And then I thought I saw — just like our forefather Lehi saw — God sitting on His throne, surrounded by numberless rings of angels engaged in singing and praising Him. And my soul longed to be there. VerseEnd Verse23 Then I recovered and my limbs got their strength back, and I stood on my feet and declared to the people that I had been born of God. VerseEnd Verse24 And from then on I’ve worked nonstop to bring souls to repentance, to bring them to taste the great joy I tasted, so they can also be born of God and be filled with the Holy Ghost. VerseEnd

Verse25 And now, my son, the Lord has given me satisfying joy from the results of my labors. VerseEnd Verse26 Because of the word He’s freely given me, many have been born of God and have experienced what I have, and have seen with their own eyes as I have. Therefore they understand the things I’ve taught, just as I know they’re true; and the knowledge I have comes from God. VerseEnd Verse27 I’ve been strengthened in the face of every one of my trials and troubles, and in all my suffering. Indeed, God has rescued me from prisons, chains, and death — yes, I put my trust in Him and know He’ll always rescue me. VerseEnd Verse28 I know He’ll raise me up on the last day to live with Him in glory, and I’ll praise Him forever. He brought our ancestors out of Egypt, and He drowned the Egyptians in the Red Sea, and He led them by His power into the promised land. He has freed them from slavery and captivity from time to time. VerseEnd Verse29 He also led our ancestors out of the land of Jerusalem, and He has, by His everlasting power, freed them from slavery and captivity from time to time, all the way down to the present time. And I’ve always kept in mind their enslavement; and 2PSF you also ought to remember their enslavement, as I have. VerseEnd Verse30 But, my son, this isn’t everything. I promise 2PSF you that to the extent 2PP you keep God’s commandments, 2PP you’ll prosper in the land; and I promise 2PP you that to the extent 2PP you don’t keep God’s commandments, 2PP you’ll be cut off from His presence. Now this is based upon His word. VerseEnd

LEChapter37 Verse1 And now, my son Helaman, I command 2PSF you to take the records that have been entrusted to me. VerseEnd Verse2 And I also command 2PSF you to maintain a record of this people on the plates of Nephi, in the same way I have, and keep these things sacred which I’ve protected, just as I’ve kept them sacred. They’ve been maintained and kept safe for a wise purpose. VerseEnd Verse3 Also protect these brass plates containing these engravings, which have the records of the holy scriptures on them and our ancestors’ genealogy, from the very beginning. VerseEnd Verse4 It has been prophesied by our forefathers that they’re to be maintained and kept safe and handed down from one generation to another, to be protected and preserved by the Lord until they’re published to all people of every nation, tribe, and language, to let them know of the mysteries they contain. VerseEnd Verse5 Now if they’re protected and maintained, they’ll absolutely retain their brilliance. And they will do so! So will all the plates containing sacred writings. VerseEnd

Verse6 Now 2PSF you may think that I’m being foolish. But I tell 2PSF you great things are accomplished by ordinary, simple things. And simple methods, in many instances, prove the wise are wrong. VerseEnd Verse7 The Lord God can use anything to accomplish His great and eternal purposes. And by very simple methods the Lord proves the wise wrong and accomplishes the salvation of many souls. VerseEnd Verse8 Now it has been wisdom in God for these things to be kept safe until now. Because they’ve increased our people’s memory and convinced many of the error of their ways and brought them to the knowledge of God, for the salvation of their souls. VerseEnd Verse9 Indeed, I tell 2PSF you: If it weren’t for the things contained in the records on these plates, Ammon and his companions wouldn’t have convinced so many thousands of the Lamanites of their ancestors’ false traditions. It was these records and their content that brought them to repentance; that is, they let them know of the Lord who is God and to rejoice in Jesus Christ their Redeemer. VerseEnd Verse10 And who knows whether they might turn out to be instruments in bringing many thousands more of them — and even many thousands of our stubborn fellow Nephites also, who are now hardening their hearts in sin and iniquities — to know of their Redeemer. VerseEnd Verse11 Now I don’t fully know about that future, so I’ll stop there. VerseEnd Verse12 It may be enough to simply say these records are kept safe for a wise purpose, a purpose that’s known to God. Because He wisely guides all His works, and His direction is straight and He moves continually in one eternal round. VerseEnd

Verse13 Remember, remember, my son Helaman, how strict God’s commandments are! He has said: To the extent 2PP you keep God’s commandments, 2PP you’ll prosper in the land; and to the extent 2PP you don’t keep God’s commandments, 2PP you’ll be cut off from His presence. VerseEnd Verse14 And now remember, my son, that God trusts 2PSF you with these sacred things, which He made sacred and which He’ll watch over and keep safe for His own wise purpose, to preserve His influence with future generations. VerseEnd

Verse15 Now I tell 2PSF you by the spirit of prophecy that if 2PSF you go against God’s commandments, 2PSF you’ll lose these sacred things by God’s power and 2PSF you’ll be handed over to Satan, and he’ll abuse 2PSF you. VerseEnd Verse16 But if 2PSF you keep God’s commandments and guard these sacred things as the Lord commands 2PSF you (and 2PSF you should always ask the Lord about how to accomplish 2PSF your responsibilities), then no power of earth or hell can take them from 2PSF you, since God has the power to vindicate all His words. VerseEnd Verse17 He’s sure to fulfill any promise He may make to 2PSF you, since He’s kept the promise He made to our forefathers. VerseEnd Verse18 He promised them He would protect these things to preserve His influence with future generations. VerseEnd

Verse19 And now He has fulfilled one purpose: that is, to restore thousands of Lamanites to the knowledge of the truth. He’s increased His influence with them. And He’ll likewise yet exert His influence through them to future generations. Consequently, they will be preserved. VerseEnd Verse20 So I command 2PSF you, my son Helaman, to be diligent in following all my words and diligent in keeping God’s commandments as they’re written. VerseEnd

Verse21 Now I’ll tell 2PSF you about those 24 plates: 2PSF You must keep them safe, so that the mysteries and their dark, secret schemes, the conspiracies of those people who were destroyed, can be revealed to this nation. They will need to hear about all their murders, robberies, plundering, wickedness, and abominations. And 2PSF you must preserve these Directors. VerseEnd Verse22 When the Lord saw His people began to fall into dark acts and to commit secret murders and abominations, the Lord warned that if they didn’t repent, they would be altogether annihilated from the earth. VerseEnd Verse23 The Lord said: I’ll prepare a stone for My servant Gazelem that will bring their dark acts into the light, so I can expose for the people who serve Me the errors, depravity, and abominations of the earlier believers who fell into secret wickedness and dark works. VerseEnd Verse24 And now, my son, these Directors were prepared to accomplish the prophecies of God, which He committed to have happen, saying: VerseEnd Verse25 I’ll expose to public view, out of darkness into light, all their secret offenses and their abominations. And unless they repent, I’ll destroy them and annihilate them from the earth. And I’ll bring to light all their secrets and abominations to every nation who will inhabit the land after this. VerseEnd Verse26 And now, my son, we see they didn’t repent; therefore they’ve been removed. And so far God’s word has been fulfilled; indeed, their secret abominations have been brought out of darkness and revealed to us. VerseEnd

Verse27 And now, my son, I command 2PSF you to not publish all their oaths, covenants, and agreements used in their secret abominations; indeed, 2PSF you must continue protecting this people from all their signs and conspiracies, so they don’t learn them, so they can’t risk falling into darkness as well, and also be destroyed. VerseEnd Verse28 Remember, there’s a curse on all this land that any people who choose darkness until they’re fully ripe in iniquity, will be destroyed by God’s power. That being the case, I don’t want this people to be destroyed. VerseEnd Verse29 So 2PSF you must protect this people from these secret plans of their oaths and covenants. And only reveal to them the wickedness, murders, and abominations. 2PSF You must teach them to reject and regard such wickedness, abominations, and murders with disgust. 2PSF You must also teach them the reason those people were destroyed was due to their wickedness, abominations, and murders. VerseEnd Verse30 Indeed, they murdered all the Lord’s prophets who came among them to condemn their iniquities. And the blood of those they murdered cried out to the Lord their God for vengeance upon their murderers. As a result, God’s judgments were imposed upon those who practiced that darkness and were part of the secret conspiracies. VerseEnd Verse31 And may the land be cursed forever against those who work in darkness, to their utter destruction, unless they repent before they’re fully ripe. VerseEnd

Verse32 Now, my son, remember the words that I’ve spoken to 2PSF you. Don’t entrust those secret plans to this people, but teach them an everlasting hatred for sin and iniquity. VerseEnd Verse33 Preach to them repentance and faith in the Lord Jesus Christ. Teach them to humble themselves and to be meek and humble in heart. Teach them to resist every temptation of the accuser with their faith in the Lord Jesus Christ. VerseEnd Verse34 Teach them never to grow tired of doing good, but to be meek and humble in heart — because then they’ll find rest for their souls. VerseEnd Verse35 Remember, my son, and learn wisdom while 2PSI you’re young; indeed, learn to keep God’s commandments while 2PSI you’re young. VerseEnd Verse36 Cry to God in prayer — in all that 2PG you do — for help, strength, and comfort; and do everything 2PG you do for the Lord. And no matter where 2PG you go, go with the Lord. Direct all 2PG your thoughts to the Lord and always place 2PG your heart’s desires on the Lord. VerseEnd Verse37 Consult the Lord in everything 2PG you do, and He’ll direct 2PG you for good. When 2PG you lie down at night, lie down directing 2PG your thoughts and feelings to the Lord, asking Him to watch over 2PSF you in 2PSF your sleep. When 2PG you get up in the morning, let 2PG your heart be full of thanks to God. And if 2PSF you always do these things, 2PSF you’ll be lifted up on the last day. VerseEnd

Verse38 Now, my son, I want to discuss the thing our forefathers called a ball or Director — or rather, they called it Liahona, which translates to a compass — that the Lord provided. VerseEnd Verse39 And no one can accomplish such intricate workmanship. It was provided to point the way for our ancestors to travel in the wilderness. VerseEnd Verse40 And it worked for them based on their faith in God. As a result, if they had faith to believe God would make the pins point the way to go, then it happened. Therefore they saw this miracle, and many other miracles, performed by God’s power day after day. VerseEnd Verse41 However, even though those miracles let them accomplish miraculous things, they happened by ordinary methods and they got lazy, took it for granted, and neglected to exercise their faith and diligence. So then the miracles stopped, and they didn’t make progress in their journey. VerseEnd Verse42 Then they wandered in the wilderness, no longer traveling a direct path, and suffered hunger and thirst due to their faithlessness. VerseEnd

Verse43 Now, my son, I want 2PSF you to understand these things foreshadow coming events. As our ancestors were disinclined to pay attention to this physical compass, they didn’t advance; so it is with spiritual things. VerseEnd Verse44 Because it’s the same thing to pay attention to Christ’s word, which will point out to 2PSF you a straight path to eternal bliss, as it was for our ancestors to pay attention to this compass, which would point out to them a straight path to the promised land. VerseEnd Verse45 I ask 2PSF you: Isn’t the one symbolic of the other? Because just as surely as this Director brought our ancestors, by following the way it pointed, to the promised land, so will Christ’s word, if we follow the way it points, take us beyond this valley of tears into a much better promised land. VerseEnd

Verse46 My son, let’s not get lazy because the way is simple, because our ancestors were like that. They had the way opened for them; if they would just look, they could live. And it’s the same for us: the way is still open; and if we choose to look, we can live forever. VerseEnd Verse47 And now, my son, please care for these sacred things. Indeed, see that 2PSF you look to God and live. Go minister to this people and declare the word, and be serious in mind and purpose. Farewell my son. VerseEnd
